content:
Successful HWPX document renewal achieved by strictly removing layout cache elements and ensuring proper namespace handling during XML manipulation.
The primary driver of success was the removal of <hp:linesegarray> elements from modified <hp:p> paragraphs to prevent rendering inconsistencies. Dynamic namespace discovery using root.nsmap and URI-based searches ensured compatibility across HWPX versions. The process maintained file integrity by using ZIP_STORED for the mimetype and ZIP_DEFLATED for other components after sorting CSV inputs by sequence.
